name: Skylight
description:
An infinite canvas window manager. Every window on one endless canvas at its real size; your screen is a camera. Pinch or Super+scroll to zoom out and see everything, pan with two fingers on the desktop, click a window to step into it at 1:1. Drag windows with alignment guides and a drop grid, resize them from their edges, tile them with Move & Resize keys, tidy everything, save and restore layouts.

At 1:1 your windows are completely normal and interactive.
